facts.statement: The study used a genetic technique called MADM to track individual cell lineages and single-cell methods to examine how the Pten gene affects the development of radial glial cells in the cortex.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: When the Pten gene was removed, the number of projection neurons produced by radial glial cells doubled, and the production of astrocytes in the cortex increased significantly.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Experiments showed that without Pten, the process of making astrocytes becomes disconnected from normal growth factor signals and instead relies on the MAPK signaling pathway.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The findings suggest that the Pten gene controls the development of radial glial cells in a step-by-step manner to ensure the cortex grows to the correct size.
facts.subject: animals
